events.title: Asian Shares Tumble As AI Fears Deepen
events.description: Asian stocks ended mostly lower on Wednesday, with Japanese and South Korean markets leading regional losses, on doubts over whether massive technology spending can generate sufficient returns.

events.title: European Shares Seen Higher As Oil Prices Retreat; US PCE Inflation Data Eyed
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a firm note on Wednesday as oil prices retreated despite Strait of Hormuz attacks and Ukraine's ongoing attacks on Russian oil refineries.

events.title: Indian Shares Inch Closer To Record Highs
events.description: Indian shares opened on a buoyant note on Wednesday, bringing benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty closer to their record highs as softer crude oil prices and renewed foreign fund inflows outweighed fresh U.S. tariff worries.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Wednesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling below the 8,700 level, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower On Tech Rout
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Wednesday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with markets in Taiwan, South Korea and Japan leading the losses, amid a selloff in semiconductor and technology stocks on renewed doubts on AI trade's durability. Supply disruption concerns and inflation risks emerged amid ongoing threats to energy shipments across the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply lower on Wednesday, reversing some of the sharp gains in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 57,250 level, with weakness in index heavyweights, financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in automaker stocks.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Wednesday after the previous session's selloff as FIIs continue their buying trend and oil prices remain soft on concerns over rising supply.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Open Under Pressure On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the three-day slide in which it had given up almost 35 points or 2.2 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,450-point plateau and it's expected to open to the downside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Halt Winning Streak
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, collecting almost 100 points or 1 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,240-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: Australian shares are trading notably lower on Wednesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling below the 8,700 level, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Take Further Damage On Wednesday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished lower in six straight sessions, sinking almost 1,100 points or 4.6 percent in that span. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 22,220-point plateau and it's likely to extend its losses again on Wednesday.

events.title: Soft Start Seen For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, gathering more than 14 points or 0.4 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,550-point plateau although it may spin its wheels on Wednesday.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, soaring more than 4,100 points or 10.1 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 40,120-point plateau although it may run out of steam on Wednesday.
